subject: MedSys request: consolidated IAM evidence package for CAIQ/SIG review
messages:
From: Megan Lee <procurement@medsys-example.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@medsys-example.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IAM artifacts for CAIQ / SIG review

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for making time. As part of our CAIQ/SIG intake for the procurement review we need a compact IAM evidence packet covering SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, and a least-privilege attestation. Specifically:

- SCIM delta export showing provisioning activity for the last 90 days (CSV or JSON)
- 3–5 anonymized SAML assertion samples (covering web UI and API SSO flows)
- Current RBAC/role matrix for production and staging (role -> permission mapping)
- Brief attestation that least-privilege reviews were completed and the date of last role pruning

Do you have a confidentiality / redaction workflow for these exports? Our legal/infosec needs the artifacts by EOD 2027-04-19. If you can confirm a point of contact and how you prefer to share the files (secure Drive link or SFTP), that would be helpful.

Best,
Megan Lee
Procurement Lead, MedSys Health
megan.lee@medsys-example.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Megan Lee <procurement@medsys-example.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM artifacts for CAIQ / SIG review

Hi Megan — thanks for the checklist and clear deadlines. We can deliver the requested artifacts. High-level plan:

- SCIM delta export (90d): we will generate a CSV and run PII redaction on user emails and external ids.
- SAML assertions: we will provide 4 samples with PII removed and timestamps preserved.
- RBAC matrix: redacted XLSX that maps roles to permissions for prod + staging.
- Attestation: short signed statement from our security team confirming last role/pruning date.

Point of contact on our side will be me (mina_haddad@redwood.com). For transfers we prefer a secured Google Drive folder with link & view-only protected by link expiration; deliverables will also be uploaded to a temporary SFTP if you prefer.

Requesting 48–72 hours to gather and redact the exports; if you must have everything by 2027-04-19 we will prioritize and aim to deliver by EOD 2027-04-14.

Does MedSys require a notarized attestation or is an email-signed statement sufficient?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Request: IAM artifacts for CAIQ / SIG review

Laura / Irene — forwarding the MedSys ask. Key deliverables and timeline in the original note (deadline requested 2027-04-19; we should push to 2027-04-14 delivery).

Irene: can you pull the SCIM delta (90 days) and the SAML assertion samples? Please sanitize user identifiers (hash emails) and mark service accounts clearly. We should include a short README describing fields and redaction approach.

Laura: please review the RBAC matrix we produce and sign the attestation about least-privilege review. Also confirm whether the redaction approach below (SHA256 hashing of user emails + truncation of UUIDs) is acceptable for procurement.

Proposed schedule:
- Tue 2027-04-13: Irene provides SCIM CSV + assertion samples to me for redaction review (internal).
- Wed 2027-04-14 AM: Laura reviews RBAC matrix + approves attestation language.
- Wed 2027-04-14 PM: Deliver redacted folder to MedSys.

Please reply with any blockers or if we need legal to sign any additional NDAs.

> 
> Best,
> Megan

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: IAM artifacts for CAIQ / SIG review

Mina — on it. Notes from the export side: 

- SCIM delta export (2027-01-13 -> 2027-04-13) will be ~48k rows for the tenant; I will provide a filtered export for accounts in scope (production tenants only) to reduce size. File: scim_delta_export_20270413.csv
- SAML assertions: I will grab 4 assertion blobs from our logging pipeline and run the standard PII redaction script. Output file: saml_assertion_samples_anon.txt (each sample prefixed with a minimal header: flow, timestamp, assertion-id).
- Service account mapping: do you want us to include a separate mapping for service accounts and API keys? This would be an additional CSV (~2k rows) but could help with attestation context.

For redaction we will: SHA256-hash user email, remove subject/NameID fragments, and truncate internal UUIDs to 8 chars. We will keep timestamps intact to preserve traceability. If procurement needs raw, unredacted samples for an on-site auditor, legal will need to sign access controls; please advise.

I can deliver the initial artifacts to the secure Drive folder and tag them: PENDING_REVIEW.

Irene Choi
IAM & Identity Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Megan Lee <procurement@medsys-example.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@medsys-example.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Delivery: MedSys IAM evidence packet (redacted)

Hi Megan / Tom — attached is the compiled, redacted evidence package for your CAIQ/SIG intake. The same files are available in a time-limited Drive folder (link below) and in HubSpot under company record MS-7421.

Attachments included:
- scim_delta_export_20270413.csv (90-day filtered SCIM delta for production tenants; emails hashed)
- saml_assertion_samples_anon.txt (4 anonymized SAML assertion samples with headers)
- rbac_matrix_redacted_20270414.xlsx (role -> permission mapping; user identifiers removed)
- attestation_least_privilege_20270414.txt (signed by Laura Bennett, Director Security)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMedSysEvidence (expires 2027-04-28)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/7421

Notes:
- Redaction approach: SHA256 hashing for user emails, UUID truncation to 8 chars, service accounts labeled SERVICE_ACCOUNT-*.
- If your auditors require unredacted artifacts for an onsite review, please confirm the legal request and we will route via our compliance team.

If you need anything else (additional assertion samples, extended delta range, or the service-account mapping CSV), let us know and we can schedule a quick handoff session with Irene.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
